text_block_list.text:
Today, Грасс Вандер officially begins
her quest
through the Twinkle Series!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Eager to discuss what lies ahead, I head
to her
classroom so I can walk her to the
office myself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Spe? That kanji character isn't
quite
right.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-which one?! Where?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(Looks like she's talking to Special
Week—an
Umamusume from Hokkaido
who's in the same
year as her.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on. First, let's try and chill
for a
second. I can't see the paper with
your hands in
the way.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
(And that's Сэйун Скай, who is also
making her
debut soon. Her manner of
communication can be
a tad indirect at
times.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You have the wrong radical on the left
side of
"whirlpool." The one you've
written makes the
kanji for "disaster."
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Um, um, um... So, I need to do it like...
this?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
What chicken scratch is that, Spe?! I've
seen
better handwritin' from a six year
old!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Meanie!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Dear me. If even El is correcting your

penmanship, I fear you may have a long
way to
go...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hey!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
(Another classmate in the same year, El
Condor
Pasa is an Umamusume with a
big and bright
personality. She also
shares a room with Grass
Wonder.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Spe, there's plenty of time.
Just take
a few deep breaths and correct
the mistake.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I-I'll try!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! I didn't realize you were
here.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! You're Grass's trainer! Is she late
for
training?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ngh... I'm so sorry! It's all my faaault!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Urgh... You see... I scored so bad on our
quiz that
I have to do extra homework!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
She's not allowed to train until it gets
done,
either.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
However, with our debuts coming up,
she can't
afford to miss a single session.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Exactamente! So, less tears and more
writing,
Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Spirit! Guts! Effooort!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: A little effort before the test would've been nice too, though.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: I know, I knooow!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, that is the situation,
Trainer.
Would you mind waiting a little
longer?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now, let's continue, Spe.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Haste makes waste. This is the perfect

opportunity to refocus and learn from
your
mistake.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Think about what a whirlpool is made of.
Water,
right? So the correct kanji should
have the
"water" radical.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
O-oh! That makes sense! I can remember
that!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер skillfully gives concise but
useful
advice to help Спешл Уик
finish her extra
homework.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: You all seem like good friends.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I really value our friendship. Each
of them
is quite different, which makes
our time together
enjoyable.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Though of course, that isn't all...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
As members of the same generation, we
are
bound to face one another many
times on the
track as rivals.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Her expression remains calm as she says
this.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But something about her aura makes my
skin
prickle ever so slightly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, you wanted to discuss our plans
from here
on, right?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I know we need to talk about things like
training
and our race agenda.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: But I have something to give you first.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
With that, Грасс Вандер holds out a
piece of
calligraphy paper.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I unfold it and see confident, bold lines
that spell
out...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Determination.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I will follow the path I have chosen,
never backing
down, until I reach the
top.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: This... is my promise in writing.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Trainer. Would you carry it with you?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's just a folded piece of paper, but it's
as if I can
feel the weight of the
conviction she's poured
into it. I
carefully tuck it away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Let's begin the ascent.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And with that, our journey is underway.
Debut
race, here we come!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
